BLUEPEARL WESTSIDE FAMILIES: Our Cobb and Sandy Springs hospitals have united and will be serving you at our Sandy Springs location! Our trusted team will continue to provide the same care you’ve come to expect.
We are committed to making this transition as smooth as possible for you and your pets. If you have any questions or need assistance with your pet’s medical records, please contact us.
Thank you for your continued trust and support—we look forward to continuing to care for your pets at our Sandy Springs hospital.
BluePearl Pet Hospital – emergency vet and specialty animal hospital serving greater Atlanta.
We are located just off of Roswell Road in Abernathy across from the Sandy Springs Tennis Center. We serve much of Georgia and the Atlanta metro area, including Roswell, Woodstock, Marietta, Smyrna, Tucker, Brookhaven, Dunwoody and Alpharetta.
Our reviews.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, seconds count. Our team is ready to provide expert care 24/7 in case of a pet emergency. If your pet requires a veterinary specialist, we are ready for that too. Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians and support staff work closely together to provide the comprehensive, compassionate care your pet needs and deserves.
24-hour emergency services
Call ahead to our 24-hour emergency vet and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary.
Learn more about your emergency visit
.
Specialty veterinary care
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Sandy Springs.
Easily accessible off State Route 400, our hospital was founded in 1988 as Georgia Veterinary Specialists, the largest private multi-specialty veterinary hospital in Georgia. We feature 19 exam rooms, five surgical suites, an intensive care unit and a parvo ward.
Our hospital features an MRI, CT scanner and other state-of-the-art diagnostic equipment. We also have an intensive care unit.
Pet owners.
At BluePearl Pet Hospitals, providing our customers with remarkable service is a top priority. We’re committed to making your veterinary visit as smooth as possible.

“We brought our 12 year old Boston terrier Chester in for fear he ate a bad mushroom out in our yard! All of your staff were so kind/caring & very professional! Everything turned out to be ok with our Chester! I will most definitely be a repeat customer if need be! And I am a pet groomer of 36 years and I have lots of customers that I will highly recommend to you all! Thank you sooo much!” – Renee’
